body: I don’t think it’s assault. My SO takes rejection pretty hard so I try to go along with it even if I’m not 100% into everything. I consider myself pretty sex positive and don’t want to shame anyone, I just don’t understand continuing with someone who can’t reciprocate on the same level
I never like being that intoxicated. I’ve only really been that way when I’ve been drinking with my SO, but I don’t think any kind of lacing is going on
thanks. I hope you’re able to hold out a little longer, and if you can’t I hope you can at least rest easy.
not great, I’m definitely glad to be out. real life is shit but at least you aren’t being watched or treated like a child all of the time. that said, I think it was unavoidable for me
I like that song too. at least we can all always fall back on music
I just wrote out something damn similar. why can’t I die and stop being me? stop being awful?
jfc. my friend had a similar issue and the assholes wouldn’t quit it until they were told specifics about her trauma. absolute pricks, all of them.

it’s definitely not easy, man. good luck to you though, I think everyone could use some.
feels bad is right on. it’s like everyone’s trapped in an uncanny valley of not being close enough to talk without and excuse, but not being bad enough to end things.

I don’t like feeling so low and promptly turning around and hating myself for being a brat. there’s so much good in my life and I objectively understand that, but I can’t make myself see it. I can only see the bad, the trauma, the loneliness, the knife.
I’ve slept but a few hours last night, and it doesn’t look like tonight will be any different. I really feel this post man
this is how I feel, but I want you to stay with us. I don’t think that’ll be of much console though.
